prompt:
超写实室内床上人像摄影，竖版约 4:5，一名明确成年的东亚女性，20+，坐在白色床铺上，背后是深灰黑色软包床头。摄影者位于人物正前方略偏低位置，采用约 28–35mm 等效镜头近距离拍摄，人物从头部完整拍到大腿中部，双腿在前景明显展开，占据画面下半部，形成轻微近大远小透视。

人物为非常明显的丰满沙漏型身材：肩部中等偏窄，胸部非常丰满且自然，腰部明显收细，髋部宽而圆润，大腿根部丰厚有真实软组织体积。整体重点是丰满上身＋细腰＋宽髋＋丰厚大腿，不要纸片身材、窄胯细腿、健美肌肉或夸张假体感。

人物坐在床面中央，上半身略微向后靠，双手分别撑在身体左右两侧的床面 / 枕头上，手肘微弯。双腿大幅向左右打开并屈膝，左侧大腿更靠近镜头，占据画面左下较大面积；右侧大腿向画面右下展开。骨盆正对镜头，姿势放松自然，不要跪姿或站姿。

人物留乌黑色中长发＋厚碎齐刘海，头发在后脑松散扎起 / 盘起，少量长碎发垂在两侧脸颊和颈部，整体略凌乱。佩戴大号银色圆环耳环。脸型小巧偏鹅蛋形，肤色白皙偏暖，眼妆为黑棕色细长眼线和浓密睫毛，淡粉腮红，嘴唇为裸粉珊瑚色。头部轻微向人物左侧倾斜，双眼直视镜头，表情冷淡、安静、略带慵懒感，嘴唇自然微张。

人物穿一套蓝黑色蝴蝶翅膀印花比基尼。上身为细黑色挂脖三角比基尼上衣，肩颈只有极细黑色系带，罩杯图案模拟蝴蝶翅膀：主体为浅天蓝 / 冰蓝色大面积翼片，外缘为深藏蓝和黑色轮廓，带白色小斑点和细线纹理；胸下用一条细黑色系带横向连接。版型贴合身体，完整正常覆盖。

下身为同款极细侧带低腰三角比基尼裤，腰线很低，左右为细黑色系带，前片同样是浅蓝＋深蓝黑色蝴蝶翼纹样，尺寸较小但保持完整覆盖。整体不要改成泳衣连体、普通纯色比基尼或蕾丝内衣。

场景为简洁现代卧室。人物背后是一块高大的深灰黑色软包床头板，表面为哑光织物或皮革，分成大块矩形拼接。右后方堆着纯白色枕头和白色被子，床单也是白色；左侧边缘可见少量灰色墙面。环境不需要其他家具，保持干净、简单。

光线采用正面数码相机直闪＋昏暗室内环境光。闪光直接照亮人物脸部、胸肩、腹部和大腿，使肤色呈明亮暖白 / 奶油色；背景床头板明显更暗，白色被褥出现高亮反射。人物腿部和腹部有自然柔和阴影，不要电影级侧光。

整体呈 2000s–2010s 室内数码相机 / CCD 私房写真抓拍质感：轻微硬闪、有限动态范围、背景暗、皮肤高光明显、少量颗粒、轻微 JPEG 压缩感，不要过度 HDR、商业棚拍或塑料磨皮。

重点锁定：成年东亚女性＋床上正面坐姿＋双腿大幅屈膝展开＋双手向后撑床＋非常丰满沙漏身材＋超丰满胸部＋细腰＋宽髋＋丰厚大腿＋黑色碎刘海＋松散盘发＋银色大圆环耳环＋蓝黑蝴蝶翅膀印花挂脖比基尼＋低腰细带比基尼裤＋深灰软包床头＋白色床品＋正面直闪＋近距离数码相机抓拍。

避免：纤细纸片身材、窄胯细腿、健美肌肉、长直披发、高马尾、普通纯色泳装、连体泳衣、蕾丝内衣、丝袜、鞋子、站姿、跪姿、双腿并拢、豪华酒店背景、强背景虚化、电影柔光、动漫脸、CG 感、多余肢体、水印和乱码文字。

promptTranslations.en:
Ultra-realistic indoor bed portrait photography, vertical orientation approximately 4:5, an explicitly adult East Asian woman, 20+, sitting on a white bed with a dark gray-black upholstered headboard behind her. The photographer is positioned directly in front of the subject at a slightly low angle, shot closely with an approximately 28–35mm equivalent lens, fully framing the subject from head down to mid-thigh, with legs prominently spread out in the foreground occupying the lower half of the frame, creating a subtle wide-angle perspective distortion (foreshortening).

The subject has a very prominent voluptuous hourglass figure: moderately narrow shoulders, very full and natural breasts, a noticeably tapered narrow waist, wide and rounded hips, and thick upper thighs with realistic soft tissue volume. The overall focus is a voluptuous upper body + narrow waist + wide hips + thick thighs; avoid skinny waif figures, narrow hips and slim legs, athletic/bodybuilder muscles, or exaggerated unnatural implants.

The subject sits in the center of the bed, upper body leaning slightly back, both hands braced on the bed surface / pillows on either side of her body with elbows slightly bent. Legs are bent at the knees and spread wide apart to the left and right; the left thigh is closer to the camera, occupying a significant portion of the lower left frame; the right thigh spreads toward the lower right of the frame. Pelvis faces directly toward the camera, in a relaxed and natural pose; no kneeling or standing postures.

The subject has jet-black medium-long hair + thick wispy straight bangs, hair loosely tied / pinned up at the back of the head, with a few wispy strands hanging down along both cheeks and neck, slightly messy overall. Wearing large silver hoop earrings. Small, slightly oval face shape, fair and warm-toned skin, eye makeup featuring dark brown slender eyeliner and dense eyelashes, light pink blush, and nude pink-coral lips. Her head is tilted slightly toward her left, eyes looking directly into the camera lens with a cool, calm, slightly languid expression, lips naturally slightly parted.

The subject wears a blue-and-black butterfly wing print bikini. The top is a thin black halter triangle bikini top, with only ultra-thin black straps around the neck and shoulders; the cup pattern mimics butterfly wings: the main body features large sections of pale sky blue / ice blue wings, with outer edges in deep navy and black contours, accented with small white spots and fine line textures; connected horizontally under the bust with a thin black string. The cut fits the body snugly, providing full, normal coverage.

The bottom is matching low-rise triangle bikini bottoms with ultra-thin side ties, sitting very low on the hips, with thin black tie strings on the sides, the front panel also featuring light blue + dark navy-black butterfly wing patterns, small in size yet maintaining complete coverage. Overall, do not change to a one-piece swimsuit, plain solid-color bikini, or lace lingerie.

The setting is a minimalist modern bedroom. Behind the subject is a tall dark gray-black upholstered headboard, with a matte fabric or leather surface divided into large rectangular quilted panels. Piled in the right background are pure white pillows and a white duvet, with matching white bedsheets; a small section of gray wall is visible on the far left edge. No other furniture is needed in the environment, keeping it clean and simple.

Lighting utilizes frontal direct camera flash + dim indoor ambient light. The flash directly illuminates the subject's face, chest and shoulders, abdomen, and thighs, giving the skin a bright warm-white / creamy tone; the background headboard is noticeably darker, with bright specular highlights reflecting off the white bedding. There are natural, soft shadows on the subject's legs and abdomen; avoid cinematic rim/side lighting.

The overall aesthetic has a 2000s–2010s indoor digital camera / CCD boudoir snapshot feel: subtle hard flash, limited dynamic range, dark background, pronounced skin highlights, minor grain, slight JPEG compression artifacts; avoid excessive HDR, commercial studio photography, or plastic airbrushed skin.

Key focal points: adult East Asian woman + front-facing sitting pose on bed + legs spread wide with bent knees + hands braced backward on bed + very voluptuous hourglass figure + ultra-full bust + narrow waist + wide hips + thick thighs + black wispy bangs + loose updo + large silver hoop earrings + blue-black butterfly wing print halter bikini + low-rise thin-tie bikini bottoms + dark gray upholstered headboard + white bedding + frontal direct flash + close-range digital camera snapshot.

Avoid: slender stick-thin figure, narrow hips and skinny legs, athletic/muscular build, long straight hair let down, high ponytail, plain solid-color swimwear, one-piece swimsuit, lace lingerie, stockings, shoes, standing posture, kneeling posture, legs together, luxury hotel background, heavy background bokeh, cinematic soft light, anime face, CG look, extra limbs, watermarks, and garbled text.

summaryTranslations.en: Ultra-realistic indoor direct flash portrait: Voluptuous hourglass-figure East Asian woman sitting on a bed in a butterfly bikini.

人物留乌黑色中长发＋厚碎齐刘海，头发在后脑松散扎起 / 盘起，少量长碎发垂在两侧脸颊和颈部，整体略凌乱。佩戴大号银色圆环耳环。脸型小巧偏鹅蛋形，肤色白皙偏暖，眼妆为黑棕色细长眼线和浓密睫毛，淡粉腮红，嘴唇为裸粉珊瑚色。头部轻微向人物左侧倾斜，双眼直视镜头，表情冷淡、安静、略带慵懒感，嘴唇自然微张。

人物穿一套蓝黑色蝴蝶翅膀印花比基尼。上身为细黑色挂脖三角比基尼上衣，肩颈只有极细黑色系带，罩杯图案模拟蝴蝶翅膀：主体为浅天蓝 / 冰蓝色大面积翼片，外缘为深藏蓝和黑色轮廓，带白色小斑点和细线纹理；胸下用一条细黑色系带横向连接。版型贴合身体，完整正常覆盖。

下身为同款极细侧带低腰三角比基尼裤，腰线很低，左右为细黑色系带，前片同样是浅蓝＋深蓝黑色蝴蝶翼纹样，尺寸较小但保持完整覆盖。整体不要改成泳衣连体、普通纯色比基尼或蕾丝内衣。

场景为简洁现代卧室。人物背后是一块高大的深灰黑色软包床头板，表面为哑光织物或皮革，分成大块矩形拼接。右后方堆着纯白色枕头和白色被子，床单也是白色；左侧边缘可见少量灰色墙面。环境不需要其他家具，保持干净、简单。

光线采用正面数码相机直闪＋昏暗室内环境光。闪光直接照亮人物脸部、胸肩、腹部和大腿，使肤色呈明亮暖白 / 奶油色；背景床头板明显更暗，白色被褥出现高亮反射。人物腿部和腹部有自然柔和阴影，不要电影级侧光。

整体呈 2000s–2010s 室内数码相机 / CCD 私房写真抓拍质感：轻微硬闪、有限动态范围、背景暗、皮肤高光明显、少量颗粒、轻微 JPEG 压缩感，不要过度 HDR、商业棚拍或塑料磨皮。

重点锁定：成年东亚女性＋床上正面坐姿＋双腿大幅屈膝展开＋双手向后撑床＋非常丰满沙漏身材＋超丰满胸部＋细腰＋宽髋＋丰厚大腿＋黑色碎刘海＋松散盘发＋银色大圆环耳环＋蓝黑蝴蝶翅膀印花挂脖比基尼＋低腰细带比基尼裤＋深灰软包床头＋白色床品＋正面直闪＋近距离数码相机抓拍。

避免：纤细纸片身材、窄胯细腿、健美肌肉、长直披发、高马尾、普通纯色泳装、连体泳衣、蕾丝内衣、丝袜、鞋子、站姿、跪姿、双腿并拢、豪华酒店背景、强背景虚化、电影柔光、动漫脸、CG 感、多余肢体、水印和乱码文字。
translations.en:
Photorealistic indoor bed portrait photography, vertical ~4:5 ratio, an adult East Asian woman, 20+, sitting on a white bed with a dark grey-black upholstered headboard behind. Low-angle close shot with ~28-35mm lens, capturing head to mid-thigh, legs spread in foreground creating perspective.

Voluptuous hourglass figure: narrow shoulders, naturally very busty, slim waist, wide hips, thick thighs with realistic soft tissue. Focus on curvy silhouette, no muscular or overly fake features.

Sitting centered, leaning slightly back, hands propped on bed/pillows, elbows slightly bent. Legs spread and bent at knees facing camera naturally.

Black hair with full fringe bangs, loosely tied back, silver hoop earrings, subtle makeup, neutral relaxed gaze. Wearing a blue-and-black butterfly wing print bikini (halter neck and low-rise string bottoms).

Modern bedroom setting, direct on-camera flash with dim ambient light, 2000s-2010s CCD snapshot aesthetic with slight grain and hard flash falloff.
